architecture: H^7 [product_i RZ_i(w_i.s + b_i)] [product_(i,i+1 mod 7) RZZ(theta_i)] H^7, followed by majority on all seven outcomes
neural_weights: 28 trainable weights iid Uniform[0,2pi); no feature-specific engineering
gate_initialization: b_i = pi/2 + Normal(0,0.15^2); seven edge angles iid Normal(0,0.15^2)
baseline: Original Linear(4,9)-Tanh-Linear(9,2) MLP, 65 parameters, default torch initialization
selection_reason: Highest mean AUC and earliest mean restricted solve episode among finalists evaluated on all four development seeds. All failed trials retained.
endpoints: first full rolling-100 mean >=195, restricted to 501 for unsolved runs
success: Positive paired 95 percent bootstrap confidence interval and Holm-adjusted two-sided exact sign-randomization p<0.05 for both endpoints
terminal_performance: Report final-50 and 100 frozen heldout episodes per seed separately; do not infer improved terminal quality from AUC
scope: Exact-probability CartPole experiment; not a classical-hardness or quantum-advantage claim
